verdict.rationale: GitHub Mobile's docs describe multiple ways to delegate work to Copilot directly in the app: assigning issues to Copilot for a ready-to-review PR, managing Copilot cloud Agent Tasks, natural-language chat with Copilot to explore code and open PRs, and Copilot code review on PRs. This is a clear built-in AI delegation capability, not just a companion feature. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on community corroboration of these specific Copilot/agent features (the community evidence available predates Copilot integration and only covers general app usability issues).
